fields.title: 3. Probabilities and Value — No Change
fields.md:
- Of the probability adjustment rules R1–R6, none was satisfied by this event. R5 (new wildfire losses exceeding $1 billion in a quarter) is on hold, as there was neither a ruling nor new recognition (Source: [10-Q R31](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1067983/000119312526452412/R31.htm)). Scenarios stay at 25/50/25.
- assumed value band $265.0–$684.5 · probability-weighted $469.6 · base $464.4 — same as the first round's values (formulas and sources are in the valuation section of the [2026-11 report](2026-11.md)).
- Price update (close): Class B $575.25 (2026-11-09, [stockanalysis](https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/brk.b/history/)) — 23.9% above the base present value (formula 575.25 ÷ 464.4 − 1). P/B 1.61x (formula 575.25 ÷ 357.73). With the exit P/B fixed at 1.45x, the implied BPS compounding is 10.3% (formula (575.25 × 2.411 ÷ (357.73 × 1.45))^(1/10) − 1).
- Market cap about $1,224.3 billion (formula 575.25 × 1,418,900 × 1,500) − net cash $356.9 billion − equities $335.5 billion = value assigned to operating businesses about $531.9 billion → 14.0x annualized after-tax operating earnings excluding investment income of $38.08 billion (formula 531,872 ÷ 38,080, same approximation as the first round).
- Re-estimating the discount rate is for the next monthly round (2026-12) — the reference value (10-year yield 4.86%, 2026-11-06 → 9.1%) is as in Section 4 of the previous round (Source: data/latest.json meta.macro.ust10).
